seo.title: Your Company — wedding and portrait photographer in Tashkent
seo.description: Weddings, portraits, content for brands and short films. Candid reportage without posing, film-style colour, finished photos in 3 weeks.
seo.answer: Your Company is a photo and video studio in Tashkent: wedding reportage from 6,000,000 UZS per day, a studio portrait from 1,200,000 UZS per hour, brand content from 4,500,000 UZS. Finished photos are delivered in 3 weeks, previews in 3 days; a date is booked with a 30% deposit.

business.street: 7 Mukimi St, studio on the 3rd floor
business.areaServed: Tashkent, Samarkand, Bukhara, travel across Uzbekistan

sections.title: Light that stays
sections.subtitle: Weddings, portraits and shoots for brands. No staged poses or plastic retouching — candid frames with film colour that you’ll want to print.

sections.label: Studio
sections.title: Timur Rakhimov, photographer
sections.text: I’ve been photographing people for ten years: more than two hundred weddings, hundreds of portraits, campaigns for restaurants and clothing brands. I shoot digital and film and build the colour by hand for every story. On a shoot I’m almost invisible — the best frames happen when people forget about the camera.

sections.label: How we work
sections.title: From the first call to the print

items.title: Getting to know you
items.text: We talk through the day, the place and the mood. The date is booked with a deposit.

items.title: Shoot plan
items.text: A week before the shoot we put together a timeline and a list of key shots and people.

items.title: The shoot
items.text: I work quietly and close by. At a wedding — from getting ready to the last dance.

items.title: Developing and colour
items.text: I select the frames and build the colour by hand. Preview in 3 days.

items.title: Gallery
items.text: An online gallery, full-size files and lab prints if you like.

items.quote: We never noticed when he was shooting. Then we saw everything in the photos: how Dad’s hands were shaking and how Grandma was laughing.
items.author: Malika & Aziz

items.quote: The campaign was delivered in ten days, and the colour matched our style exactly. The photos still work in our ads.
items.author: Lola N.

items.q: When will the photos be ready?
items.a: A preview of 30–40 frames 3 days after the wedding, the full gallery in 3 weeks. Portrait sessions — in 7 days.

items.q: Do you hand over the raw files?
items.a: I deliver every good frame, colour-graded, at full size. I don’t hand over RAW files: they are the negative, and the colour is part of the authorship.

items.q: Do you travel to other cities?
items.a: Yes, across Uzbekistan and abroad. Travel and accommodation are paid by the client; travel days are not charged.

items.q: How do I book a date?
items.a: A 30% deposit under a contract is enough. The rest is paid on the day of the shoot. If the date moves, the deposit moves to the new one.
Yes, I can add 1–2 rolls of 35 mm or medium format to any package: developing and scans are included.

items.q: Do you have your own studio?
items.a: Yes, a 90 m² daylight studio on Mukimi St — for portraits, catalogues and product shots.

sections.label: Booking
sections.title: Which date shall we hold?
sections.text: Send me the date, the city and a few words about yourselves — I’ll reply within a day.
